caption: This drawing depicts an ornate mantel clock with intricate decorative detailing in shades of brown and gold. The base and main body of the clock are elaborately carved with swirling, floral, and scroll-like patterns. On the left side, a seated figure in classical armor, including a helmet with a plume, is resting an arm on a shield and supporting their head with a hand, appearing to be in a pensive pose; this figure is also rendered in brown tones to match the overall color scheme. On the right side, a circular clock face is embedded in the ornate case. The clock face has black numerals from 1 to 12 and two black hands, surrounded by a gold and white border with gilded designs. Above the clock face, the decorative case rises to a crest adorned with an additional scroll and leaf-like embellishments. The entire arrangement sits on an elaborate base with repeating motifs, all drawn in a manner that highlights the detailed craftsmanship of the objects. The background of the drawing is a plain beige color, providing contrast to the clock and figure.
title: Ansonia Clock
